position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 23.250, v -5.000 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'villa' overlaid with the frontage row: 2½B brick on a wide lot, the house the register associates with Silas B. Cobb (an open association, so the id names no one): the villa family's low hip with dormers over the traced body, its frame porch as the sheet draws it, restrained as the register asks ('no borrowed named mansion facade'). T-1917 reads it. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 4106726448 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
